messages:
maya: quick follow-up from the postmortem — paging churn around the metrics-exporter after the midnight deploy. want owners, short-term mitigation, and verification plan.

jon: i'll take alert tuning. current: instant error-rate > 0 -> pages. short-term: change to 5m rolling avg + require 2/3 samples to fire. add a 10m post-deploy suppression tag. i’ll open PR today. :+1:

lee: i'll own dedupe and routing. propose dedupe_key = `exporter_instance:region` and route pages during scheduled maintenance to `ops-backfill` rota with a lower priority. will test in staging. PR target: Thu.

ops-lead: note acceptance criteria: 7-day rolling reduction in pages >= 60% and no increase in user-facing errors. owners must attach dashboard snapshots to close. also add a runbook note to escalate if db-related alerts also fire.

jon: adding synthetic test and before/after fire counts to PR. quick config i'll add:
```yaml
alert: metrics-exporter-error-rate
condition: avg_over_time(5m) > 0.03
require: 2_of_3_windows
suppression:
  when_tag: deploy=true
  window: 10m
dedupe_key: "exporter_instance:region"
```

lee: staging dedupe results look good — three duplicates collapsed into one page. will push WIP PR.

oncall-bot: incident 2919999999 marked resolved by maya — duration 1h12m — postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2919999999 (auto)

maya: timeline recap: jon PR today, lee PR Thu, ops-lead runbook note in 4 business days. checkpoint next Tue 09:30 to review metrics. /remind @ops-team checkpoint next_tue 09:30

jon: PR up now — includes benchmark of daily fires (before: ~18/day, after sim: ~3/day). tagging WIP.

lee: draft routing change up for review, will validate oncall routing tomorrow.

ops-lead: thanks. owners, update the postmortem action list with PR links + acceptance screenshots. i'll close items once criteria met. :white_check_mark:
